3. The respondents herein as the plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No.07 of 2001 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar, Kishoregonj, stating, inter alia, that the kabuliyat in the name of Tunu Miah pursuant to Settlement Case No.1014 (12) 77-78 is illegal, fraudulent and not binding upon the plaintiffs and also for eviction of the defendant from the suit land. The suit was decreed by the trial Court in favour of the plaintiffs by the judgment and order dated 30.06.2004. 

 7. Mr. Mahbubey Alam, learned Attorney General, appearing on behalf of the appellant, submits that the suit land having been recorded as khas land of the Government and the Government being owners and possessors of the same having settled the suit land vide Settlement Case No.1014(12)77-78 and accepted a registered kabuliyat dated 24.05.1979 and the suit having been filed on 09.01.2001, is barred by limitation, but the High Court Division committed an error in rejecting the revisional application on the ground of limitation without considering the validity of the decree passed in the suit. He further submits that there being no statutory limitation for filing a revisional application before the High Court Division, the High Court Division committed an error in rejecting the revisional application without considering the merit of the case.
